sources.title: Miyoshi — Berry Pop SAKURA original technical sheet
sources.enumerated_scope: One literal variety code and displayed market label in the complete one-page English sheet; not a lifetime portfolio.
sources.limitations: Source pairs 19FAG-1 with Berry Pop SAKURA; no approved alias or equivalence to Japanese history labels. The printed revision is Ver.2, 8 March 2021, not a verified publication date. Domestic Japanese comparative data is not a universal trait or commercial growing region. Embedded fruit photos remain original-document references; separate hosted image URLs and reuse permission are not established.

names.portfolio_context: The 2021 English sheet displays Berry Pop SAKURA with variety code 19FAG-1. Its comparisons are based on tests in Japan; Benihope is a comparator. The original sheet includes named fruit pictures. Review the code/market-label pairing before accepting an alias.

non_portfolio_context: Benihope is a sourness comparator, not another company release from this sheet.
The sheet says its data is based on domestic comparative tests in Japan; Brix, temperature and harvesting windows are source claims, not universal traits or commercial footprint.
Filename 19fag1 is not the literal sheet code 19FAG-1 and must not create another identity.
Berry Pop is a series; Japanese history labels are not automatically equivalent to this English label.
Named fruit photos are embedded in the original PDF. No separately hosted image URL or reuse permission established; footer reserves all rights.
